article.title: Chicano Cultural Resistance, a Case Study Across Generations
article.author: Tanya Mote
article.content: Denver has ranked among the top seven most gentrified cities in the country every decade since the 1970s. During the pandemic, it was one of the fastest gentrifying cities in the country, second only to San Francisco. Surging eviction rates in 2024 forced thousands of people out of affordable housing and the record pace continues in 2025. Tenant representation is historically low. In 2026… Source
